title: MetricRecord
description: A single metric emission. Fixing the shape and the names at Phase 0 is what lets the Phase 5 Grafana dashboards and the docs/LATENCY_BUDGET.md alerts be written once and keep working — a renamed metric silently empties a panel rather than erroring.

compatibility.notes: RENAMING A METRIC IS MAJOR and additionally requires updating every dashboard and alert rule in deploy/observability. Changing a metric's `unit` or `type` after release is also MAJOR: Prometheus will happily ingest the new values alongside the old, producing a series that is silently wrong rather than broken. Adding a new metric name is MINOR.

name.description: OTel convention: lionel.<component>.<operation>.<measure>. Enforced by pattern so a typo'd metric name fails at emission rather than becoming an orphan series nobody notices.

unit.description: Histograms in this system are milliseconds unless stated. `1` is the OTel dimensionless unit.

labels.description: Prometheus labels. KEEP CARDINALITY LOW — never put turn_id, session_id, a file path, or free text here. A high-cardinality label is the standard way to take down a Prometheus instance; correlation belongs in traces, not label values.

budget_target_ms.description: Present on latency histograms that map to a row in docs/LATENCY_BUDGET.md. Carrying the target alongside the measurement is what turns the budget from a document into an alert.

reserved_names.$comment: Normative inventory. Every histogram maps 1:1 to a LATENCY_BUDGET.md row.
reserved_names.alerting: p95 over target across a 5-minute window. p50 hides the tail the user notices; max fires on every cold start.
